scope: Project self-knowledge and usage tutorials: local reviewed bilingual manual, bounded model topic selection, safe UI cards, independent guide, preserved analysis binding and persisted messages. No new native hardware acceptance or forecasting accuracy claim.
guarantees_checked: Model output is restricted to candidate topic IDs; steps and links match the public reviewed manual exactly.
Invalid/extra/unknown model output falls back to the local manual after one attempt; no repair loop.
Help with a bound historical report leaves its identity and content unchanged, adds no financial analysis_context, and persists four unique messages across two turns.
Ordinary finance/science, explicit calculations and actual report interpretations retain their original routes.
Help catalogue/search links make no model or broker request; keylike search text is rejected before entering a browser request URL.
Native help uses the existing page/bridge with a same-panel guide. No CSP, desktop bridge, voice permission or executable expansion.
limits: Intent routing and reviewed manual are finite rules/content; not arbitrary source-code understanding or universal language accuracy.
The model selects manual topics; it does not freely author or verify operation steps, and this feature is not model fine-tuning.
Viewport and speech tests use a desktop browser and controlled fixtures; no new physical mobile/Windows hardware certification.
Source drift requires review; startup hashes and labels are provenance, not proof of each statement.

runtime.desktop_connection_after_restart: Explicitly reconnect the chosen conversation; no automatic old-session selection.

package_integrity: Generated separately by dist/package_check_v16.json; not inferred from this feature report.
